text:
Jiwoo Park: starting a bring-up for nova-v2 (q5) on int4. smoke evals show ellipsis (U+2026) + zenkaku punctuation folding weirdness in KR/ZH samples. not a huge BLEU delta but outputs truncate mid-line.
Carlos Mendez: can you paste a small repro and the exact eval prompt? also which tokenizer (sentencepiece v0.1 vs patched)?
Jiwoo Park: repro: ```zh: 今天天气真好……我们去散步吧。
kr: 오늘 날씨가 정말 좋네요……산책 갈래요?``` dev note: when detokenized we sometimes get "今天天气真好" missing trailing ellipses or converted to three halfwidth dots depending on quant profile.
Maya Singh: Huh. sounds like a token merge at quant stage. Which quant kernel? int4 per-channel? Any diffs between int8 and int4 on same model?
Jiwoo Park: int8 and fp16 behave fine. int4 qlora-like profile + fused-kernel shows merge. token ids near boundary (1142/1143) map to different grapheme sequences after rounding. Also saw kvcache split before ellipsis causing partial output.
Carlos Mendez: steps I will run: 1) tokenizer.serialize on sample 2) model.generate with --use-kvtest 3) diff token ids and detok. I'll try now. @Maya can you run a quick quant parity check?
Maya Singh: on it — will run int8 vs int4 parity across 1k locale-specific samples and post summary. short idea: add a targeted unit that forces preserving U+2026 as single token during detok to avoid fold loss.
Jiwoo Park: filed a quick issue with logs and sample: https://redwood.internal/issue/9234 — includes dump of token ids and model logits around step where ellipsis disappears.
Carlos Mendez: good. if parity check confirms quant kernel rounding is culprit we should: 1) add a translation-route fallback to fp16 for KR/ZH heavy routes, 2) patch quant kernel table, 3) add a regression test in qa-suite.
eval-bot: queued run nova-v2-int4-zenkaku-ellipsis (job 8853). ETA ~12m.
Maya Singh: results: preliminary parity shows 0.3 BLEU drop mean on int4 for the locale set and ~7% of samples had truncated trailing punctuation. attaching short diff in thread.
Jiwoo Park: thanks — will follow up with a tiny tokenizer mapping PR if kernel change takes longer. adding this to the onboarding checklist so future bring-ups include locale-ellipsis smoke. :thumbsup:
